runner: headless Chrome (SwiftShader) over CDP; real mouse input on DOM controls and canvas

steps.name: define-first-visit
steps.action: Open the app with an empty browser profile
steps.expected: One project preselected, intent input and starters, Rules mode stated, no resume prompt, no site set-up page

actual.mode: Rules mode — offline, no language model

steps.name: define-brief
steps.action: Click the starter 'Connected flower resources along the paths…'
steps.expected: Explicit brief: pollinators + continuity on, what was read is shown

steps.name: define-layer-toggle
steps.action: Open Layers, hide 'Site vegetation'
steps.expected: Layer hidden in the view; the site query (crowns, distances) is unchanged

steps.name: define-unknowns
steps.action: Read the knowledge panel
steps.expected: Sources listed with counts; illustrative layer labelled not verified; unknown site data stated

actual.text: Coverage over the 240 plants of the site: flowering months 27 %, pollinator groups 22 %, light 27 %, moisture 43 % — 27 % of plants carry illustrative values.

steps.name: structure-start
steps.action: Click 'Continue to Structure'
steps.expected: Structure stage; plan view; eligible beds outlined; prompt to select a bed

steps.name: structure-B1-bands
steps.action: Click bed B1 on the canvas, then the Bands card
steps.expected: Numbered cells adapted to the bed, with the reason shown

actual.explanation: Bands parallel to the path along the bed (65.6 m of path edge) (99°), 2.5 m wide, cut into equal segments of about 7.5 m along their length.
notes: Sun, soil moisture and pH have no data here: they do not shape the cells.
1 edge fragment (< 30 % of a cell) merged into a neighbour.

steps.name: structure-B1-confirmed
steps.action: Click 'Confirm cells'
steps.expected: Cells committed; B1 emptied in a working draft, other beds keep the reference

steps.name: structure-back-and-return
steps.action: Click '← Define', then 'Continue to Structure'
steps.expected: Brief and cells unchanged

steps.name: structure-A2-honeycomb
steps.action: Click bed A2 on the canvas, then Honeycomb
steps.expected: Hex cells adapted to A2

actual.explanation: Cells parallel to the path along the bed (63.7 m of path edge) (103°), 3.5 m across.
notes: Relief in the bed is 0.23 m: elevation is not used to orient or classify.
Sun, soil moisture and pH have no data here: they do not shape the cells.
9 edge fragments (< 30 % of a cell) merged into a neighbour.

steps.name: structure-A2-confirmed
steps.action: Confirm
steps.expected: A2 cells committed; B1 unchanged

steps.name: structure-TE-organic
steps.action: Click TE (triangle bed with an existing tree crown) in the bed list, then Organic patches
steps.expected: Patches from a clipped Voronoi; crown inside the bed

actual.explanation: 19 patches from a clipped Voronoi partition (Lloyd relaxation, 2 steps) of seed layout 3 of 6: the layout whose patches mix the fewest known site conditions (tree crown, path edge, elevation tercile) and leave the fewest slivers.
notes: Sun, soil moisture and pH have no data here: they do not shape the cells.

steps.name: structure-TE-confirmed
steps.action: Confirm
steps.expected: Three beds structured

steps.name: compose-start
steps.action: Click 'Continue to Compose'
steps.expected: First action is Suggest / Create a mix; cells shown unassigned (hatched)

actual.task: Start with a mix: a reusable recipe of plants, roles and proportions. You will paint it into the numbered cells.

steps.name: compose-suggest
steps.action: Click 'Suggest mixes'
steps.expected: Rules-mode candidates with members, roles, proportions, coverage, rationale; labelled not AI

target.note: Light is read from existing tree crowns (inference); soil moisture has no data.

steps.name: compose-accept
steps.action: Accept the first two candidates
steps.expected: Two mixes in the project library (origin: rules)

steps.name: compose-auto
steps.action: Click 'Auto compose', check the preview, Accept
steps.expected: Every unassigned cell proposed; accept places real plant instances (model rows = project instances)

actual.rule: greedy marginal gain: coverage + continuity + balance + variety − conflict; ties by cell id, then mix id

steps.name: compose-inspect-cell
steps.action: Click cell TE·1 on the canvas (no brush)
steps.expected: Inspector opens only now: conditions (crown), mix, placed vs target

actual.inspector:

steps.name: compose-paint-drag
steps.action: Click 'Paint' on the second mix and drag across five A2 cells
steps.expected: One gesture = one assignment = one undo step; plants replaced in those cells only

steps.name: compose-undo-redo-esc
steps.action: Click Undo, then Redo, then press Esc
steps.expected: Undo restores the previous plants, redo the painted ones; Esc leaves paint mode

steps.name: compose-3d
steps.action: Click 'Axo'
steps.expected: The same plants and cell tints in the existing 3D model (one record set for 2D and 3D)

steps.name: compose-edit-shared-mix
steps.action: Edit mix 1: type 'keep the grass matrix, increase spring bloom', Propose, Apply, Save → Update all
steps.expected: A patch, not a regeneration; preview of affected plants; only that mix's cells rearranged

matched: keep the matrix: matrix members are not changed
spring bloom: add scilla-mischtschenkoana (known flowering Mar, Apr; source illustrative)

steps.name: compose-add-knowledge
steps.action: Edit mix 2 → 'add what you know' on a plant → type a note → Read my note → Save (this project)
steps.expected: Claims reviewed before saving; original words kept; project scope; committed design unchanged

record.original: Here it keeps flowering into October and I saw moths on it in the evening.
record.statement: Here it keeps flowering into October and I saw moths on it in the evening.

steps.name: explore-start
steps.action: Click 'Continue to Explore'
steps.expected: Same design, planting view by default

steps.name: explore-pollinator-months
steps.action: Click 'Pollinators', then April, June, August on the timeline
steps.expected: Resource cells, groups and continuity per month from the placed plants; the design is not changed

steps.name: explore-views
steps.action: Click 'Adaptability', then 'Seasonality'
steps.expected: Match / conflict / uncertain from known traits; per-plant flowering in the month

steps.name: explore-issue-to-compose
steps.action: Click an issue, then its action (Edit mix / Reassign)
steps.expected: Returns to Compose with the mix or cells selected; then back to Explore

steps.name: knowledge-workspace-and-back
steps.action: Click 'Knowledge' in the top bar, then 'Design'
steps.expected: Knowledge workspace over the design; back to the same stage and view

steps.name: explore-save-export
steps.action: Type a snapshot name, click 'Save snapshot', click 'Export planting data'
steps.expected: Snapshot read back from storage; export file with brief, cells, mixes, every plant x/y/z, performance, caveats

steps.name: reload-resume
steps.action: Reload the page, click 'Resume this design'
steps.expected: Same brief, cells, mixes, assignments, plant positions and stage

actual.brief: Connected flower resources along the paths for bees and butterflies.

steps.name: explore-compare
steps.action: Click 'Compare' on the snapshot
steps.expected: Same metric definitions side by side; knowledge-version difference flagged if any

actual.table:
Now vs “First pass”
	snapshot	now
plants	3,090	3,090
species	10	10
brief months with a resource	7 / 7	7 / 7
pollinator groups per month (mean)	4.6	4.6
flowering known (plants)	100 %	100 %

The knowledge in use differs from the snapshot's: some differences come from knowledge, not design.

Close

steps.name: narrow-layout
steps.action: Narrow the window to 820 px
steps.expected: Panel below the canvas; stepper numbers only
